business_description_source: Family-owned, based in Haile Plantation (Gainesville), 20+ years of experience serving Alachua County. Licensed and insured. Services: painting, flooring, kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovations, custom shower installations, cabinet installation & refinishing, countertop replacement, tile installation, drywall installation and repair, commercial tenant buildouts.
prices_source: No fixed price list published; Google Business Profile and reviews describe project based work, quoted per job

reviews_verbatim.texto: We had a great experience with our floor installation. The same crew worked the installation from start to finish. Leo, the company owner, came by 1-3 times per day while the flooring was being installed, and the lead installer worked closely with us to ensure that the 10 laminate patterns were evenly distributed throughout the many rooms. I do recommend this company.

We would highly recommend Leo and his team for any job. Everything about this company is top-notch. His communication is on point, he really paid attention to what we were looking for, listened closely and did exactly what we asked. The quality of the work is fantastic, very detailed oriented and clean. We're so happy we found him. We will be using him for many future jobs!

Excellent experience from start to finish. The team was very professional and attentive to every detail. From the first consultation to the final delivery, they made sure to understand exactly what I wanted and the result exceeded my expectations. The quality of the work is impeccable and you can see the commitment they have to doing things well. In addition, they kept everything clean and organized during the process, which is very much appreciated. Without a doubt, I recommend them 100% for any remodeling project.

Leo's iHome Gainesville worked on repainting the pool deck in May last year and installing vinyl floors for two guest rooms this month. We are extremely happy with their work. Leo's crew is very professional and goes out of their way to make things great. Highly recommended.
